headline: Terms & Conditions

children.text: Simply Enak Terms & Conditions. Last updated: August 2026. 1. Booking & Payment. Full payment is required at the time of booking unless otherwise agreed. Prices are in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) and include all food and guide services. 2. Cancellation Policy. Private tours: Cancellations 72+ hours before: RM 50 administrative fee only (full refund minus fee). Cancellations 72–24 hours before: 50% charge plus RM 50 fee. Cancellations within 24 hours or no-show: full charge. Join-in/public tours: Same policy but with a 24-hour window instead of 72 hours. We reserve the right to cancel tours due to extreme weather — full refund offered. 3. Dietary Requirements. We accommodate vegetarian, vegan, halal, and common allergies. Please inform us at least 48 hours before the tour of any specific dietary needs. 4. Health & Safety. Participants should be in reasonable health for light walking (approximately 2km). Please inform us of any medical conditions that may affect your participation. 5. Photography. We may take photos during tours for marketing purposes. Let us know if you prefer not to be photographed. 6. Liability. Simply Enak is not liable for loss, injury, or damage to personal property during tours. Participants join at their own risk. 7. Changes to Terms. We reserve the right to update these terms. Continued booking after changes constitutes acceptance. 8. Contact. For questions about these terms, contact booking@simplyenak.com.

headline: Privacy Policy

children.text: Simply Enak Privacy Policy. Last updated: June 2026. 1. Information We Collect. We collect information you provide when booking a tour, including your name, email address, phone number, and dietary requirements. We also collect anonymized usage data through Google Analytics. 2. How We Use Your Information. We use your information to process bookings, communicate about your tour, improve our services, and send relevant updates (with your consent). 3. Data Sharing. We do not sell your personal information. We share necessary data with our payment processor (TicketingHub/Stripe) and email provider (Resend) for booking fulfillment. 4. Data Retention. We retain booking data for 3 years for accounting purposes. Marketing data is retained until you unsubscribe. 5. Your Rights. You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing hello@simplyenak.com. 6. Cookies. We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies (Google Analytics) for anonymous usage tracking. 7. Security. We implement industry-standard SSL encryption and follow data protection best practices. 8. Contact. For privacy inquiries, contact hello@simplyenak.com.
